about: Campaign Two §4.6 controlled FR/EN voice-to-capability evaluation corpus. Engines: voice_intent (src/ai/voice_intent.py compile_intent), normalize_lang (detect_lang), normalize_screen (check_control_reference), migrate_parse (src/runtime/migrate.py parse_request). safety=no_proposal means the case MUST never yield a proposal (ambiguous/uncertain speech). question_contains is matched case-insensitively against clarifying_question.
